# MindSage Documentation Map

Use this file as the low-token entrypoint for AI coding tools.

## Core

- `README.md` — product overview, Docker, backend/vector-store setup, API summary.
- `INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md` — step-by-step install and MCP setup for AI agents.
- `SECURITY.md` — security boundaries and reporting process.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — development workflow and privacy rules.
- `AGENTS.md` — operational instructions for coding agents.

## Architecture And Strategy

- `docs/PRODUCT-STRATEGY.md` — product direction and local-first positioning.
- `docs/COMPETITIVE-ANALYSIS.md` — comparison with GBrain and OpenBrain.
- `docs/PII-ARCHITECTURE.md` — PII anonymization and de-anonymization model.
- `docs/CONSENT-DESIGN.md` — consent filtering design.
- `docs/BROWSER-CONNECTOR-DESIGN.md` — browser connector architecture.
- `docs/CHROME-WEB-STORE-PLAN.md` — extension publishing plan.

## Security And Quality

- `docs/SECURITY-AUDIT-2026.md` — security audit and fixes.
- `docs/RED-TEAM-REPORT-2026.md` — red-team findings and fixes.
- `docs/SEARCH-PERFORMANCE.md` — search benchmark report.
- `scripts/check-open-source-ready.sh` — local open-source readiness gate.

## Key Code

- `server/index.ts` — Express API.
- `server/vector-store-client.ts` — backend client for vector store.
- `server/browser-connector/` — browser launch, capture, and extension routes.
- `server/connectors/` — connector implementations.
- `vector-store/mcp_vector_store/mcp_server_http.py` — vector store HTTP/MCP server.
- `vector-store/mcp_vector_store/mcp_server_stdio.py` — stdio MCP wrapper.
- `vector-store/mcp_vector_store/agent_schema.py` — dependency-light machine-readable integration schema for AI coding tools.
- `vector-store/mcp_vector_store/agent_pack.py` — dependency-light schema pack, safe path classifier, and corpus-level schema detector for agent intake planning.
- `vector-store/mcp_vector_store/agent_health.py` — dependency-light 0-100 memory health gate for AI coding tools.
- `vector-store/mcp_vector_store/agent_capture.py` — dependency-light CLI for one-shot document or typed-memory capture into local/remote REST APIs.
- `vector-store/mcp_vector_store/agent_think.py` — dependency-light CLI for shell-native cited `think` queries against local/remote REST APIs.
- `vector-store/mcp_vector_store/agent_import.py` — dependency-light CLI for shell-native local text corpus import into local/remote REST APIs.
- `vector-store/mcp_vector_store/agent_search.py` — dependency-light CLI for shell-native ranked passage search against local/remote REST APIs.
- `vector-store/mcp_vector_store/think_tool.py` — PII-safe cited reasoning, gap analysis, cited-answer graph, safe entity graph, and citation-maintenance engine.
- `vector-store/mcp_vector_store/entity_graph.py` — PII-safe organization/location/technology/entity graph builder for cited evidence.
- `vector-store/mcp_vector_store/maintenance_tool.py` — actionable stale/undated/weak/conflicted citation repair plans, background snapshots, schedulable review plans, dry-run apply batches, and redacted JSONL maintenance ledgers.
- `vector-store/mcp_vector_store/memory_tool.py` — typed memory records, lifecycle filters, retention, workspace summaries, actor activity, audit timelines, and relation graphs.
- `vector-store/mcp_vector_store/remote_auth.py` — dependency-light bearer-token rules for authenticated remote MCP.
- `vector-store/mcp_vector_store/agent_evals.py` — replayable agent-memory evals.
- `vector-store/mcp_vector_store/corpus_evals.py` — replayable fixture-corpus retrieval and PII-safety evals.
- `vector-store/mcp_vector_store/pii_protection.py` — PII protection.
- `vector-store/mcp_vector_store/txtai_store.py` — txtai-backed search storage.
